_comment: Concern taxonomy (Phase 7, item 0). Types are matched IN ORDER - first pattern hit wins - so specific vocabularies (accreditation) run before broad ones (employer_recognition). 'addressable': can published content answer this objection? false = structural/factual - a GEO rec must not pretend content fixes it; 'reframe' is the honest mitigation. 'probe' drives the item-1 body search over QC's own content. Patterns are case-insensitive regex fragments OR'd together.

types.label: Not formally accredited / recognized
types.reframe: Publish one transparent explainer of what QC certifications are and are not (proprietary vocational certificates, BBB business accreditation vs academic accreditation, association alignment) so engines quote QC's own framing instead of inferring the gap - content cannot make QC accredited and must not claim to.

probe.question: Does QC publish transparent content about tuition cost, payment plans, and the value/ROI of its courses?
Does QC describe hands-on, practical components of its courses (practicum, working with real dogs/clients, workshops, in-person options)?

types.label: Tutor feedback / support quality
types.reframe: Operational: tutor response times and feedback depth are a service problem; content can only set expectations (publish the actual feedback SLA and mentorship model), not fix slow feedback.

types.label: Course content depth / freshness
types.reframe: Product: dated or shallow course material is a curriculum problem for the education team, not a GEO problem - update the courses, then let updated outlines/syllabi be crawlable.

types.label: Online format requires self-discipline
types.reframe: Inherent to online learning; at most publish expectation-setting content (time commitment, pacing, completion tips). Low priority.

probe.question: Does QC surface independent third-party reviews or ratings (Trustpilot, Google Reviews, BBB reviews) rather than only self-hosted testimonials?

types.label: Employers / industry may not value the certificate

probe.question: Does QC publish employer outcomes, alumni success stories, hiring statistics, or employer testimonials showing its certificates are valued?
